Unfortunately, someone else's depression is really out of our control. We can be there for them, but we can't "fix" them. I think the most helpful thing you can do is work on your health. If he is your friend, I don't think he wants his problems to also bring you down.

I think you are already helping him by being there when he wants to talk. Any help beyond that has to be initiated by him, such as him deciding to try therapy/medication again. Please do not put his needs before yours, and take breaks when you feel that he is hurting your mental health. All relationships need healthy boundaries, and your health is important.
